title: Bamboo poles and split slats
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of bamboo: culms side by side with nodes at uneven heights, node ridges, sheath scars and waxy bands, fibre streaks and spotted mottles, or split slats as in a blind or mat. Use for fences, screens, furniture, wall cladding, rafts and tropical scenes.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python bamboo_poles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: style
parameters.meaning: 0 round culms side by side, 1 split slats (flatter, narrower strips).

parameters.name: poles
parameters.meaning: Poles or slats across the tile.

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.meaning: Nodes per pole down the tile.

parameters.name: node_ridge
parameters.meaning: How strongly each node swells into a ridge.

parameters.name: streaks
parameters.meaning: Fibre streaks and tone along the culms.

parameters.name: spots
parameters.meaning: Dark mottled spots, as on spotted (tortoiseshell) bamboo.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.meaning: Dark gap between neighbouring poles, as a share of the pole width.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Dried golden bamboo poles, as in a fence or screen.

presets.name: green_fresh
presets.description: Living green culms with pale waxy node bands.

presets.name: black_bamboo
presets.description: Black bamboo: dark purple-black culms with lighter nodes.

presets.name: split_mat
presets.description: Split bamboo slats in a mat or blind, nodes staggered.

presets.name: spotted_brown
presets.description: Spotted tortoiseshell bamboo with dark mottles.

limits: Culms are straight cylinders in a height field running down the tile, all lying in one plane; there is no taper, bend, branch, leaf, cut end or lashing. Node positions are jittered per pole, and pole widths vary but always fill the tile width exactly. The cylindrical shading is partly in the albedo as well as in the normal map. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic.
technique_references: Pole widths normalized to fill the tile width
Wrapped distance to jittered node heights per pole
Gaussian node ridge, sheath scar and wax band profiles
Stretched value noise for fibre streaks
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
